sections.shortTitle: Representation of the People Fifth Amendment Ordinance 1996
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE CXIX OF 1996
ORDINANCE CXIX OF 1996
REPRESENTATION OF THE PEOPLE (FIFTH
AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1996
An Ordinance further to amend the
Representation of the People Act, 1976
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary,
Part I, 19th December, 1996]
No.F.2(1)/96‑Pub., dated 19‑12‑1996.‑‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
Whereas it is expedient further to
amend the Representation of the People Act, 1976 (LXXXV of 1976), for the
purposes hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the National Assembly is
not in session and the President is satisfied that circumstances exist which
render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the
powers conferred by clause (1) of Article 89 of the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and promulgate the
following Ordinance:‑‑
1. Short title and commencement. ‑‑‑(1) This
Ordinance may be called the Representation of the People (Fifth Amendment)
Ordinance, 1996.
(2) It shall come into force at once

sections.description:
Amendment of section 12, Act LXXXV of 1976

ORDINANCE CXIX OF 1996
ORDINANCE CXIX OF 1996
REPRESENTATION OF THE PEOPLE (FIFTH
AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1996
An Ordinance further to amend the
Representation of the People Act, 1976
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary,
Part I, 19th December, 1996]
No.F.2(1)/96‑Pub., dated 19‑12‑1996.‑‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
Whereas it is expedient further to
amend the Representation of the People Act, 1976 (LXXXV of 1976), for the
purposes hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the National Assembly is
not in session and the President is satisfied that circumstances exist which
render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the
powers conferred by clause (1) of Article 89 of the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and promulgate the
following Ordinance:‑‑
2. Amendment of section 12, Act
LXXXV of 1976.‑‑‑In
the Representation of the People Act, 1976 (LXXXV of 1976), hereinafter
referred to as the said Act, in section 12, in subsection (2) in the
Explanation,‑‑‑
(i) in clause (a) after the figure
"1985", at the end, the commas and words, ", but shall not
include the loan the recovery of which has been stayed or suspended by any,
order of a Court or Tribunal, including the High Court and the Supreme
Court" shall be added;
(ii) for clause (b) the following
shall be substituted, namely:
"(b) 'mainly owned' shall,
other than for clause (iv) of subsection (2), mean holding of controlling and
majority interest in a business concern, and for said clause (iv), it shall
mean every person who was a director, partner or sole proprietor in a business
concern at the time the loan was written off,";
(iii) In clause (c), after the word
'authorities', at the end, the commas and' words ", but shall not include
taxes the recovery of which has been stayed or suspended by any order of a
Court or Tribunal, including the High Court and the Supreme Court" shall
be added; and
(iv) for clause (d), the following
shall be substituted, namely:‑‑
"(d) 'Government dues and
utility expenses' includes rent charges of rest houses or lodges owned by the
Federal Government, Provincial Government, local authorities or corporations
established or controlled by such Government but shall not include the
Government dues and utilities expenses the recovery of which has been stayed or
suspended by any order of a Court or Tribunal, including the High Court and the
Supreme Court; and".

ORDINANCE CXIX OF 1996
ORDINANCE CXIX OF 1996
REPRESENTATION OF THE PEOPLE (FIFTH
AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1996
An Ordinance further to amend the
Representation of the People Act, 1976
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary,
Part I, 19th December, 1996]
No.F.2(1)/96‑Pub., dated 19‑12‑1996.‑‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
Whereas it is expedient further to
amend the Representation of the People Act, 1976 (LXXXV of 1976), for the
purposes hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the National Assembly is
not in session and the President is satisfied that circumstances exist which
render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the
powers conferred by clause (1) of Article 89 of the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and promulgate the
following Ordinance:‑‑
3. Amendment of section 14, Act
(LXXXV of 1976).‑‑‑In
the said Act, in section 14, in subsection (5), in the proviso,‑‑
(i) after the word 'charges',
occurring for the first time, the words 'or has had the loan written off' shall
be inserted; and
(ii) after the word 'charges',
occurring for the second time, the words 'or the written off loans' shall be
inserted.
